components.css: .ds-recipe{display:flex;align-items:center;text-align:left;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:18px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#d4ded7);border-radius:0;gap:16px;background:none;color:#202824;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-recipe:hover{background:var(--soft,#e8f1eb)}.ds-recipe:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#185b40);outline-offset:3px}.ds-cover{font:36px/1 'Apple Color Emoji','Segoe UI Emoji','Noto Color Emoji',sans-serif;flex-shrink:0;width:52px;text-align:center}.ds-copy{flex:1}.ds-copy strong{font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;display:block}.ds-meta{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#526158);margin-top:6px}.ds-recipe svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:var(--muted,#526158);stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}

narrative.overview: Accepted direction: A — Index, chosen by the developer on 2026-09-21 ("Take variant A"). Saved Recipes lead the app, with separated rows, strong sans headings, green actions, and emoji Covers. Native implementation and production validation remain future work.
dos: Do use the accepted Index direction as the reference for future native implementation.
Do treat the HTML prototype as the source for these extracted values.
Do preserve labelled navigation, readable Recipe titles, visible keyboard focus, and return-to-task state.
donts: Don't promote this throwaway HTML or its study-harness dimensions into production Flutter code.
Don't infer a settled photo-Cover policy from this photography-free artifact; PRODUCT.md records that open question.
